expected_stage_rule: ascending SHA-256 of seed:namespace:key; no evaluator output or visibility result is read

predictor_contract.classifier: deterministic nearest-centroid with Euclidean distance on leave-one-cluster-out training folds
predictor_contract.input: all leaves from config/eval_checkpoint_trees.json in frozen tree order; binary paired response vector
predictor_contract.loco_rule: leave one stage-namespaced table/document/origin cluster out; all three repeated injections stay in the held-out fold
predictor_contract.majority_baseline: predict the first frozen class M; top-1=1/3 and macro-F1=1/6 on the balanced freeze
predictor_contract.signature_separability: leave-one-cluster-out macro-F1 compared with a cluster-label permutation null
predictor_contract.tie_rule: a distance tie is scored incorrect; M/R/N lexical order is used only to serialize a deterministic output

secondary_flat_hierarchy_contract.claim_boundary: secondary analysis only; aggregation is not changed after results
secondary_flat_hierarchy_contract.hierarchical_score: 10 * weighted sum(full binary response vector) using effective checkpoint-tree leaf weights

stop_conditions: Any M/R/N stage contract fails: STOP_THAT_STAGE and classify confirmatory result INVALID.
Any UID/origin leakage or fold contamination: classify INVALID.
Fewer than two population-responsive leaves: localization remains unestablished.
Expected-stage or predictor definitions change after result access: classify INVALID.
Any flat/hierarchy secondary result cannot overwrite the primary localization result.
